**Starts** once #54 is merged.

## Why

Workers find candidates by searching near a stay, or along a day's drive (tool design 2.3). These are the searches the stay researcher (#60) and the leg scout (#61) use.

## Design

- [Tool design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/tools.md), section 2.3 (`search_near` and `search_along_leg`).
- [Google design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/data-sources/google.md), sections 2.1, 2.3, and 2.4.
- [Technical spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/technical-spec.md), section 10.

## Open questions

- None.

## Do

- Add `search_near` and `search_along_leg`. They leave out the trip's rejected places.

## Done when

- Tests use saved Google responses.
- A real search for scenic viewpoints along San Francisco Day 2 (domain model, section 5.1) returns places in route order. Point Lobos is kept, and places within 2 miles of either end are dropped.
- A real `search_near` for a stay returns hours for the stay's dates only.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.

---

Moved from the [development plan](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/plan/development-plan.md#phase-26-place-searches).
